check_anthropic_url: check if a given URL is an Anthropic API endpoint using is_anthropic_url
fetch_anthropic_models: fetch available Anthropic models from the API and normalize them to OpenAI format
convert_anthropic_to_openai: convert an Anthropic Messages API payload to OpenAI Chat Completions format
convert_openai_to_anthropic: convert a non-streaming OpenAI Chat Completions response to Anthropic Messages format
convert_openai_stream_to_anthropic: convert an OpenAI SSE streaming response to Anthropic Messages SSE format
